name: Axiata Group Berhad
overview: 2026年可识别的业务公告主要为融资与流动性支持类事项，包括多笔财务援助（financial assistance）的提供，以及股东对经常性关联交易（RRPT）的授权；未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或重大合约。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比-3.2%，净利润同比-84.3%。
overview_en: The identifiable business-related announcements in 2026 mainly relate to financing and liquidity support, including several provisions of financial assistance and shareholder mandates for recurrent related party transactions (RRPT); no expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or major contract was disclosed for any business segment. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue declined 3.2% YoY and net profit declined 84.3% YoY.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告以财务援助和关联交易授权为主，未涉及具体业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly cover financial assistance and related party transaction mandates, with no segment-level expansion, reduction or contract disclosed.
